text: だから　むし・ひこうタイプの　バタフリーは　４ぶんの１しか　ダメージを　うけなくて　すむんだ！

structure.jp: むし・ひこうタイプの　バタフリーは
４ぶんの１しか　ダメージを　うけなくて　すむんだ！
structure.en: gets away with taking only a quarter of the damage!

patterns.name: 〜なくてすむ
patterns.explanation: なくて　すむ means you get by without having to do something unpleasant. うけなくて　すむ = 'gets away without taking it'.

patterns.name: 〜しか〜ない
patterns.span: ４ぶんの１しか　ダメージを　うけなくて
patterns.explanation: しか together with a 'not' verb means 'only', with a feeling that it is little. ４ぶんの１しか　うけなくて = 'taking only a quarter'.

patterns.name: 〜ぶんの〜
patterns.explanation: Parts of a whole are said with the bottom number first, then ぶんの, then the top number. ４ぶんの１ = 'one quarter'.
